I've been using this cleanser for the past year and a half and when I say one use, I mean one use. After wearing makeup all day long or even attending and event outside to sweating, this cleanser removes every ounce of dirt and oil on my face. I don't use this daily but when I need my pores to be unclogged, this is my go-to cleanser.

avis.titre: Amazing love the feel and the softness after

avis.titre: Great Cleanser for my Oily Skin

It does wash the face very clean, remove makeup. Nice products.

I have been using this same face wash for about a decade now! I would be in absolute disarray if they discontinued this. It helps treat and prevent my stress pimples and leaves my skin ready for my toner.
This is a great cream foam to help my mostly oily combination skin. Seems like it really does the job to keep my skin clean without overstripping. Use twice a day.

avis.titre: Recommend to replace the old cleanser with scrub

This cleanser does a thorough job without drying the skin. The tiny bumps around my nose and on my temples are gone and the skin feels smooth. I like it better than the future solutions cleanser.
Light. Quick and accurate. Does what a supposed to do with just a pea size of the product
My wife and I have been using this for years now and we love it.
I have been using this cleanse for a long time. You just need little amount & goes long way. Make my skin so soft after each use.

It doesn't work on waterproof makeup, due to it not being a oil cleanser. After you wash your face you get a grip on your face, so I wouldn't recommend touching your face for a little XD. It gets the makeup off though, and it doesn't hurt my skin.
Great, it's most effectual cleanser, and very well with sensitive skin.
This deep cleansing foam is amazing. Will absolutely keep purchasing it foams up good and face feels nice and clean after.

avis.titre: Cleansing Foam Needs Additional Cleansing Granules
avis.texte: Deep Cleansing Foam is an "average" cleanser from Shiseido. I wish it had some/more cleansing granules. It could be a better cleanser, but you offer so few options any longer.

One of the best face washes I have ever used. It is very difficult to use anything else once you try this, except for maybe another Shidseido face wash. Creamy, soft, exfoliating, and cleansing. It deals with my blemishes, dry skin, and oily skin moments. Plus, the bottle lasts me about a year!
For some reason shiseido products break me out in cystic acne. It's a shame but they just don't work for me.

Well first, when you're washing your face with it there's a waxy feeling and it's unpleasant. Made me get eyebrow dandruff and had breakouts. I'm happy for those who it worked well for but I'm just disappointed.
I purchased this and it is amazing! You only need a pea sized amount to wash your entire face. It's a game changer!
I love this foaming cleanser. It whips up nicely and has a hint of minty freshness that helps to clear oily and blackhead prone skin. My face looks clean and refreshed after every wash.

avis.titre: Great for oily skin, blackheads and big pores!
avis.texte: If you're like me and you find yourself get oily and shiny before mid-day thwn this is the cleanser for you! I've been using this cleanser for 10 years and nothing can ever compare. It's especially amazing during the summer, but it's totally gentle enough to use during those winter months as well. It also does wonders for my blackheads on my nose and helps with my big pores. Ofcourse, like any other cleanser you need to make sure to use day and night! And then you will get the results desired.
Been using this cleanser for a while and love it. I like Sheseido's product scent, subtle and pleasing.
Love the texture and smell of the cleanser. Feel refreshed and clean immediately

I was so disappointed to learn that the White Lucent cleansing foam had been discontinued, but I tried this product instead after being told it was a "new and improved" version of it. Unfortunately I broke out immediately after making the switch. Maybe this has to do with my background as a mixed raced Middle-Eastern / Japanese woman with acne-prone combination skin, but I have also spoken to other customers (they identify as Asian, Latina and Southeast Asian) who also didn't have a good experience with this new line. In sum, I don't think Shiseido is considering all skin types when making new formulas. It seems as if this new formula only works for a specific type of skin.

This is one of my go to facial cleansers. The creamy lather it produces, reaches all of your pores to produce a deep clean feeling. I feel as if nothing is left behind because it truly picks up all of the dirt and makeup on my skin without drying my face out. This product is a must for those with oily skin and acne marks. You will not be disappointed. I enjoy using the cleaning oil in combination with this product. Don't hesitate and add it to your daily routine.

I have blemish prone skin and use this cleanser every morning (while using something my dermatologist prescribed in the evening). It cleanses very thoroughly and leaves my skin feeling soft, nourished and prepped for my regimen. I follow it up with Eudermine, Ultimune, Essential Energy Moisturizing Gel Creme and Urban Environment Sunscreen... and feel ready to face the day.
I really love this cleansing soap I will continue to use it this product has done wonders for my skin

This is such a luxurious cleanser and really delivers what it says it's going to deliver. The soft luscious foam is not drying whatsoever and definitely removes and helped control oil. Breakouts are nowhere in sight and the bottle has lasted me such a long time. I used to use it twice a day and a pea size truly goes above and beyond! I recommend if you start noticing any dryness maybe just use it on a clean face PM only. I used to be pretty oily but I feel like I've gotten it under control and now I only use it at night to cleanse off the day. Still have plenty to go. Gentle formula that keeps random breakouts away, help control oil and leaves my skin looking fresh and youthful! Definitely recommend.
Friendly to oily skin! It keeps my face decent all day along.
I used a lot of brands and unfortunately none of them made my skin clean. I have been using this product almost for 2 months and this is the best! I am just ordering the new one!

I am using this product for many years and never disappointed.
I have used this facial cleanser for many years in all of it's forms! It is Great for me!
It is really helpful for my oil skin, specially in the area of my chin.

I have very oily skin, and with the use of facemask my skin started to breakout. This product is the saviour of my skin. Now i just need to find a product that helps with the scars.

I love this cleaner. It works great on my skin i will buy it again.

avis.titre: I have been using this for years!

Great product! Probably works a bit too well, since my skin feel pretty taunt afterwards. Would definitely recommend!

I've been using this for over a year. I have oily skin that is blemish prone and this is the first cleanser that I've used that doesn't dry my skin out and doesn't leave an oily feel. And I have tried A LOT. It's been great for my complexion!

I have oily-acne prone skin. I was recommended to this by a friend with the same skin type as me. This face wash cleared up my face and it makes my face feel so clean after without drying it out! I recommend!
This product is very good and I have purchased it for the third time. Very comfortable after washing my face.
I will never use another face wash. This cleans and leaves your skin soft and ready for the rest of your routine.
I have been using Shiseido for over 20 years and constantly get compliments on my skin. If I try other products my sensitive skin breaks out. Worth the cost.

avis.titre: Best gentle cleansing for mixed skin
avis.texte: I've been used from estee lauder, la mer, and others cleanser for the past few years. Shiseido has been over all the best and making my skin healthy and clean.

avis.titre: Finally a cleanser that can handle my oily skin!!
avis.texte: I love it. It keeps my oily skin under control. It is the best!

love this foam. You need so little. I use this on the brush and probably place a pea size amount. I scrub my face, chest, and arms all on the same pea size portion. After a month, my face is as soft as my babies tush.

avis.titre: Significant improvement with acne and ph balance.
avis.texte: For the past months i been having a really bad acne problem on my cheeks and neck, it may be for wearing facemask i get really irritated. this product really helps to my greasy face, i started noticing improvement after 2 weeks of using it, and leaves my skin with a fresh and clean feeling and look.
Love this product. Love the smell and love the way it leaves my face feel after using

This deep cleansing foam is great if I don't use it too much. It really does a great job at cleansing, even after a day of wearing makeup. I'm restricting myself to 3 times a week and it works great for me that way.

One of the few things I've found that doesn't cause my skin to react in breakouts or redness, and really cleans it well. Thank you. I'll be re-ordering this product for a very long time.

Best facial cleaner I have ever had. Very condensed and goes on so nice.
I have tried other cleansers, but this is the best one for me.
I have used this product for a month. I do have very oily skin, but this foam makes my face not oily at all during the day.

My favorite cleanser!! Can really be used for all skin types and issues. It is a must in my daily routine!

I do find it a little drying during the winter season so I just used extra moisturizer but its been doing wonders for me during spring and summer. I typically get the blue one that you can only by at Nordstroms so I branched out and got this at Sephora when I couldnt find my other one. Definitely keeping this in my skin care routine!
I still love the Benefiance Extra Creamy Cleansing Foam but that has been discontinued. This is a good substitute.

First of all, I LOVE Shiseido products. Its the brand that works on my face. This foaming cleanser is thick so I only need a pea size on my Clarisonic Mia. Its very gentle and it cleanses very well. My face is smooth and its not drying. It doesnt break me out. It helps me achieve a clear skin together with the other Shiseido products I use. I highly recommend it.

i have been using this face wash for less than a year and i would not trade it for anything. it has cleared all of my acne while not being stripping or drying. i use the massage brush to create the foam and massage that all over my face. i also had very oily skin and it has reduced the amount of oil production in my face. i would 10/10 recommend this cleanser to anyone with acne prone skin.
I have been using this product for over 10 years, and it is my must in my cleansing routine. I absolutely need to use it to clean my face everyday! It leaves my skin feeling so clean & fresh.
Good for combination to oily skin. I have combination skin and it doesn't leave my skin oily after using it. I love how it has a lot of foam. It makes my skin feel clean.

I have been using Shiseido skincare for over 15 years. I have yet to meet a product I dont like. I love this deep cleansing foam that leaves my skin so squeaky clean. I have been using this product for a few years now. The discontinued the Pureness line so I transitioned to this line. Photo included in my review is shot and edited by me.

This feels so silky when applying! I love Shiseido and used many products from the brand religiously for about 2 years when living in Minnesota. I recently moved to Texas where the weather is much hotter and humid. With the weather change, this made my skin really greasy and I started breaking out. I'm in my latter 20s and I feel Shiseido works great for cold weather climates and women in their 40s who need more hydration and anti-aging results.
This is every thing makes my skin very smooth and clean and my T spot its very oily so this is help me to reduce the oil in my skin its kinda expensive but usually I get them when they are on sale

avis.titre: This is hard for me becau
avis.texte: This is hard for me because I want to love this product so much, but it kind of tore my skin up. I love a deep cleansing foam and have used many but this one just overly strips my face to the point of discomfort and I dont have sensitive skin at all. It did in fact deep clean my pores but it did it in a way that my face was just constantly breaking out, and I have many face washes that cleanse my pores without heavy painful breakouts like this one gave me. I used it for about a month so that I would be past the purging faze that some face washes give you and it never stopped giving me painful acne and irritated stripped skin. As someone with oily skin that is never sensitive to products I can say this one is just too harsh.
This is a deep cleansing foaming cleanser for oily to blemish prone skin to anyone that is suffering with blemishes and need a little help this product would definitely take care of you as a cleanser
